description: Planted panel twin of T2: entity random intercept + within-entity AR(1) errors.
sizingNote: 2,000 entities x 6 periods = 12,000 rows (Ruling Q9: >= 2,000 x 6). Grouped-vs-random split effects and interval coverage depend on the number of independent entities; 2,000 entities give entity-cluster bootstrap SEs of about 0.04 for the random-effect SD and 0.02 for phi.
